method: Original in-place Luke-local pose channels and anatomical arm IK; no imported source clips or old-rig retargets
notes: sourceToTarget remains a vocabulary for possible future retargets, not a claim that CMU or another source was migrated. Part 2 authors the listed source-bundled motion pack directly against the unchanged canonical Luke glTF frames. The single pose writer combines sampled rotations/arm targets with gameplay ball anchors, preserves gameplay root ownership and resets from exact rest every frame. Dedicated pickup, gather and release transitions are tested and reviewed separately from static rig compatibility.
